label: Claude Haiku 5.5
output:
**Dumper: going halves?**

Lee,

I've been thinking about how much we're paying for hire every year, and I reckon we should just buy one between us. I've put the numbers down so you can have a proper look.

**What we've been paying**

This year I've hired the tracked dumper 14 days from the hire place in Sittingbourne. That's £85 a day plus £30 delivery each time, so roughly £1,600 all in. It's not just the money, either. In September they didn't have one free, so we barrowed 6 ton of muck at the Hernhill job. That cost us two extra days, and your back was gone for a week. Then there was the delivery driver who turned up at 11 and we lost half the morning waiting on him.

**What's on offer**

There's a bloke in Faversham selling a 2019 500kg tracked dumper for £1,650 ono. He says new tracks went on last spring. Split two ways, that's £825 each.

It can go in my lean-to at the yard. It's covered, so storage is sorted.

**The sums**

- At this year's use, it pays for itself in about a year.
- At half this year's use, it takes about two years.
- That's before servicing and repairs. I'd split servicing 50/50, and whoever breaks it pays for the fix.
- They hold their value well, so if it doesn't work out, we can sell it on and get most of our money back.

I've already got three patio digs and the Boughton drive booked in for spring, so we'd be using it straight away.

**Next step**

Come and have a look at it with me this Saturday before someone else snaps it up. Give it a once-over and have a go on it. If you're happy, we'll sort the money and get it moved to the yard.

Cheers
